title.narrative: Strengthening Justice and Security Sector Governance in Pakistan (Rule of Law Programme)

description.narrative: The 2030 Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) 16 and 5 re-affirm that peace, stability, accountable governance, adherence to the rule of law and achieving gender equality and empowering women and girls are essential pre-requisites for sustainable development. Strong and inclusive institutions, good governance, access to justice and security for all, and a stable economy are essential pre-requisites to achieve durable peace, development, and stability in Pakistan.
